description: Client-side script for a to-do list web application, managing tasks, filtering, editing, deleting, and persisting data in local storage.

methods.name: showTodo
methods.description: Displays tasks based on the selected filter, updating the task list in the DOM.

methods.name: showMenu
methods.description: Displays the options menu for a specific task.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the completion status of a task and saves it to local storage.

methods.name: editTask
methods.description: Prepares a task for editing by populating the input field.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Removes a task from the list and updates local storage.
